notes.title: General stuffs about this game
notes.content:
Hi, I'd like to talk about some random things about this game. I've been a game player for years and have always wanted to create my own game, and here it is. The basic idea of the game is simple, the player gets some randomly chosen upgrades and slash some randomly spawned enemies. I never expected it to be played by so many people. Thank you all for playing.

But as some features are added later, there can be some balancing problems. Like in the latest v 1.12 update I changed "HP + 20" to "HP + 50%" as no one would ever choose "HP + 20" over "HP up" which will increase both the hp and the max hp by 20. The two upgrades were designed in an earlier version where only one upgrade is presented each level.

The same issue happens with full screen. Full screen only makes the game appear larger but does not modify anything else. There is a difference in difficulty between full screen mode and windowed mode, and I can't tell which one is harder. So when you compare your best records with each other, please consider the difference between the two versions.

notes.title: Version 1.1 live
notes.content:
This is the first big update of this game and adds a lot of features.

New Features:
-- Beautiful skill icons. Thanks to @Kellon! we now have really beautiful unique icons for each skill and upgrades, instead of the ugly "up" ones.
-- Player hit sound effect. Now when you are hit, there will be a sound effect.
-- Different enemies, Now there are tank enemies and fast enemies that could be spawned.
-- Damage mechanism changed.
-- Enemy speed cap. Now there is a cap of speed for the enemies. Their speed will stop growing after level 30 when they reached the highest speed a player can get.
-- Enemy damage limited. After level 15 the damage of enemies will grow half as fast,
-- Guide menu remade. Now there is a setting screen, a weapons screen and a page 2 for skills and upgrades.

New Weapons:
Gun - a ranged weapon to shoot enemies.

New Skill:
Rapid Fire - you fire rapidly creating a bullet storm

New Upgrades:
Rapid Fire Duration Up
Explosive Round - your bullet can explode
Bullet Explosion Radius/Damage Up - upgrades to explosive round
Bullet Size Up - bigger bullet
Bullet Speed Up - faster bullet
Bullet Range Up - shoot enemies farther away
Fire Rate Up - fire faster

Skill Rebalance:
-- Fire Ball damage reduced, but it is still powerful.
-- Sword Wind frequency reduced, just so the gun has some advantages.

Due to a big change of the damage mechanism, bugs could be encountered, please report them so I can fix them.

notes.title: Something about the coming new weapon
notes.content: Hi, I've just finished building the basic mechanics for the new weapon --  the gun and it seems to be working properly. However, it feels a bit overpowered so I nerfed its damage and shot speed and even the player's hp when using it. I'm not really good at balancing stuffs, so if you guys have any ideas that could make sword and gun both have unique advantages and disadvantages, please leave a comment below.
